summary: On paper this one is close: Tennessee's best edge is to wrap up (Tennessee's defense ranks 3rd in broken tackles per touch, 10.3% missed), while Las Vegas's best counter is to move people pre-snap (Las Vegas ranks 11th in EPA per dropback with motion, +0.07). Under center, Cam Ward ranks 27th of 31 in EPA per dropback; x-factor: Under pressure, Cam Ward averages -0.96 EPA per dropback, 30th of 32, and Las Vegas' pass rush ranks 9th (23% of dropbacks). The model favors Las Vegas at 50%, mostly on home field (1.7 pts) and passing matchup (1.2 pts).

TEN.detail: Tennessee ranks 30th of 32 in EPA per dropback (-0.10), a weak spot all season.

Tennessee's defense ranks 3rd in broken tackles per touch (10.3% missed). Las Vegas ranks 30th (4.2%).

Las Vegas' defense ranks 31st in explosive play rate (9.9% allowed). Tennessee ranks 18th (8.8%).
Las Vegas ranks 29th in stuff rate (20%). Tennessee's defense ranks 13th (18% generated).
